description.en: Builds a Streamlit + Plotly dashboard (dashboard.py) from a data file, with a review step before committing.
description.es: Crea un panel con Streamlit + Plotly (dashboard.py) a partir de un archivo de datos, con revisión antes de confirmar.

nodes.question: Which data file should the dashboard use? (path relative to {{projectName}}, e.g. data/sales.csv)

nodes.text: Create a Streamlit dashboard in dashboard.py titled "{{dashboardTitle}}" that loads the data file {{dataFile}} with pandas and shows it with interactive Plotly charts (a summary of key metrics, at least two charts and a filter in the sidebar). Handle missing or malformed data gracefully. Add a requirements.txt (streamlit, plotly, pandas) if one does not exist. Do not run the app; only write the files.

nodes.message: Open dashboard.py and check that it looks right. Approve to commit the changes, or reject to stop here.
